朝.zh: 她朝我丢葡萄，我试着用嘴接住它们。
朝.pinyin: Tā cháo wǒ diū pú tao wǒ shì zhe yòng zuǐ jiē zhù tā men
朝.en: She tossed me grapes and I tried to catch them with my mouth.
朝.es: Ella me lanzaba uvas y yo trataba de agarrarlas con la boca.

朝.pinyin: Wǒ měi cháo qī shí chī zǎo cān
朝.en: I have breakfast at seven every morning.
朝.es: Desayuno a las siete todas las mañanas.

证据.zh: 他有一个有力的不在场证据。
证据.pinyin: Tā yǒu yī ge yǒu lì de bù zài chǎng zhèng jù

证据.zh: 除非有可靠的证据，不然我们不应该相信任何事。
证据.pinyin: Chú fēi yǒu kě kào de zhèng jù bù rán wǒ men bù yīng gāi xiāng xìn rèn hé shì
证据.en: Unless there is reliable evidence for it, we should not believe anything.
证据.es: A menos que haya pruebas fidedignas de ello, no deberíamos creer nada.

证据.pinyin: Wǒ cuī huǐ le suǒ yǒu de zhèng jù

命运.pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ de mìng yùn

命运.zh: 天知道他们的命运到底是什么。
命运.pinyin: Tiān zhī dào tā men de mìng yùn dào dǐ shì shén me
命运.en: God knows what their fate will be.
命运.es: Dios sabe cuáles serán sus destinos.

命运.zh: 你才是自己命运的主人。
命运.pinyin: Nǐ cái shì zì jǐ mìng yùn de zhǔ rén
命运.en: You are the master of your own destiny.
命运.es: Eres el dueño de tu propio destino.

命运.zh: 每个人都应该是自己命运的主宰。
命运.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yīng gāi shì zì jǐ mìng yùn de zhǔ zǎi
命运.en: Everyone ought to be a master of his own destiny.
命运.es: Todos deberían ser amos de su propio destino.

逻辑.pinyin: Wǒ gēn bu shàng nǐ de luó ji
Wǒ wú fǎ lǐ jiě tā de luó ji

逻辑.zh: 数学就像物理的逻辑一样。
逻辑.pinyin: Shù xué jiù xiàng wù lǐ de luó ji yī yàng
逻辑.en: Mathematics is like the logic of physics.
逻辑.es: Las matemáticas son como la lógica de la física.

逻辑.pinyin: Wǒ gēn bu shàng tāng mǔ de luó ji

投资.zh: 他们在这次的投资中得到百分之八的收益。
投资.pinyin: Tā men zài zhè cì de tóu zī zhōng dé dào bǎi fēn zhī bā de shōu yì
投资.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
投资.es: Ellos obtuvieron un 8 por ciento de interés de su inversión.

投资.zh: 更多投资在教育的钱将会刺激经济成长。
投资.pinyin: Gèng duō tóu zī zài jiào yù de qián jiāng huì cì jī jīng jì chéng zhǎng
投资.en: More money for education will spur economic growth.
投资.es: Más dinero para la educación estimulará el crecimiento económico.

投资.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
投资.pinyin: Zhèng fǔ yīng gāi jiā dà duì nóng yè de tóu zī
投资.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
投资.es: El gobierno debería invertir más dinero en la agricultura.

投资.pinyin: Tā bǎ qián tóu zī yú gǔ piào
投资.en: He invested his money in stocks.
投资.es: Él invirtió su dinero en acciones.

劝.pinyin: Wǒ men shì zhe quàn le tā

劝.en: I advise you to give up drinking.
劝.es: Le aconsejo que deje el trago.

劝.pinyin: Yī shēng quàn wǒ jiè yān
劝.en: The doctor advised me to stop smoking.
劝.es: El doctor me aconsejó dejar de fumar.

劝.zh: 有人要她去劝他刷房子。
劝.pinyin: Yǒu rén yào tā qù quàn tā shuā fáng zi
劝.en: She was asked to convince him to paint the house.
劝.es: Le pidieron que lo convenciera de pintar la casa.

生长.zh: 橘子在温暖的地方生长。
生长.pinyin: Jú zi zài wēn nuǎn de dì fang shēng zhǎng
生长.es: Las mandarinas crecen en países cálidos.

生长.zh: 稻米生长在温暖的国家。
生长.pinyin: Dào mǐ shēng zhǎng zài wēn nuǎn de guó jiā
生长.es: El arroz crece en países cálidos.

生长.zh: 水稻生长在温暖的气候。
生长.pinyin: Shuǐ dào shēng zhǎng zài wēn nuǎn de qì hòu
生长.es: El arroz crece en climas cálidos.

生长.zh: 手甲的生长速度比脚甲快四倍。
生长.pinyin: Shǒu jiǎ de shēng zhǎng sù dù bǐ jiǎo jiǎ kuài sì bèi
生长.en: Fingernails grow nearly four times faster than toenails.
生长.es: Las uñas de la mano crecen casi cuatro veces más rápido que las de los pies.

能源.zh: 我们如同无限般的使用地球的能源资源。
能源.pinyin: Wǒ men rú tóng wú xiàn bān de shǐ yòng dì qiú de néng yuán zī yuán
能源.en: We have used earth's energy resources as if they were limitless.
能源.es: Hemos utilizado la energía de la tierra como si fuera inagotable.

能源.zh: 我们必须降低能源需求。
能源.pinyin: Wǒ men bì xū jiàng dī néng yuán xū qiú

能源.zh: 阿尔及利亚会成为一个能源强国吗？
能源.pinyin: Ā ěr jí lì yà huì chéng wéi yī ge néng yuán qiáng guó ma
能源.en: Will Algeria become an energy power?

能源.zh: 阿尔及利亚能依赖可再生能源吗？
能源.pinyin: Ā ěr jí lì yà néng yī lài kě zài shēng néng yuán ma
能源.en: Can Algeria rely on renewable energy?

包括.zh: 我们处理各种书籍，包括新的和旧的。
包括.pinyin: Wǒ men chǔ lǐ gè zhǒng shū jí bāo kuò xīn de hé jiù de
包括.en: We handle all type of books, both new and old.

包括.zh: 你说普通话不好的包括你自己。
包括.pinyin: Nǐ shuō pǔ tōng huà bù hǎo de bāo kuò nǐ zì jǐ
包括.en: You yourself belong to this group of people that you're talking about - the one that doesn't speak standard Mandarin well.

包括.zh: 他的薪水包括基本工资和提成。
包括.pinyin: Tā de xīn shuǐ bāo kuò jī běn gōng zī hé tí chéng
包括.en: His remuneration consists of a base salary plus commissions.

包括.zh: 蝙蝠的食物主要包括昆虫和水果。
包括.pinyin: Biān fú de shí wù zhǔ yào bāo kuò kūn chóng hé shuǐ guǒ
包括.en: The bat's diet consists mainly of insects and fruit.

戏剧.zh: 他们不是在打架，而是在排练戏剧。
戏剧.pinyin: Tā men bù shì zài dǎ jià ér shì zài pái liàn xì jù
戏剧.en: They aren't quarreling, but are rehearsing a play.
戏剧.es: Ellas no están peleando, sino que están ensayando una obra.

戏剧.zh: 我们看到了一部揭示当下社会真实偏见的戏剧。
戏剧.pinyin: Wǒ men kàn dào le yī bù jiē shì dāng xià shè huì zhēn shí piān jiàn de xì jù
戏剧.en: We saw a theatre piece which brings the true prejudices of the present society.

戏剧.pinyin: Wǒ cān jiā xì jù shè
戏剧.en: I belong to the drama club.

戏剧.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng zài xué xí yīng wén xì jù

具体.zh: 网络是一个相通的渠道，而不是物质或具体的活动。
具体.pinyin: Wǎng luò shì yī ge xiāng tōng de qú dào ér bù shì wù zhì huò jù tǐ de huó dòng
具体.en: It’s a communication medium, not a substance or specific activity.
具体.es: Es un medio de comunicación, no una sustancia o una actividad específica.

具体.zh: 让我们来研究一个具体的例子。
具体.pinyin: Ràng wǒ men lái yán jiū yī ge jù tǐ de lì zi

具体.zh: 可以说说您的具体要求吗？
具体.pinyin: Kě yǐ shuō shuo nín de jù tǐ yāo qiú ma
具体.en: Could you tell me what your specific requirements are?

具体.pinyin: Nǐ jù tǐ xū yào xiē shén me

特色.zh: 日本有许多别具一格的特色。
特色.pinyin: Rì běn yǒu xǔ duō bié jù yī gé de tè sè
Zhè lǐ de tè sè cài shì shén me
特色.en: What is the specialty food here?

特色.zh: 你们这儿什么菜最有特色？
特色.pinyin: Nǐ men zhèr shén me cài zuì yǒu tè sè

特色.zh: 所谓的＂男性特色教育学＂根本就不存在。
特色.pinyin: Suǒ wèi de nán xìng tè sè jiào yù xué gēn běn jiù bù cún zài
特色.en: There is no "masculine" way of learning.

移民.zh: 你何时移民到我们国家?
移民.pinyin: Nǐ hé shí yí mín dào wǒ men guó jiā
移民.en: When did you immigrate to our country?

移民.pinyin: Měi guó shì yī ge yí mín guó jiā
移民.en: America is a country of immigrants.
移民.es: Estados Unidos es un país de inmigrantes.

移民.zh: 如果追根溯源的话，绝大多数美国人都是移民。
移民.pinyin: Rú guǒ zhuī gēn sù yuán de huà jué dà duō shù měi guó rén dōu shì yí mín
移民.en: Most Americans are descended from immigrants.

移民.pinyin: Xǔ duō yí mín gǎi le míng zi
移民.en: Many of the immigrants changed their names.

辩论.pinyin: Zhè shì chǎng yǒu qù de biàn lùn
Wǒ men méi yǒu shí jiān lái biàn lùn
辩论.en: We don't have time to debate.

辩论.zh: 他组织了一场关於时事的课堂辩论。
辩论.pinyin: Tā zǔ zhī le yī chǎng guān yú shí shì de kè táng biàn lùn
辩论.en: He organized a classroom debate on current events.

辩论.zh: 我认为辩论该继续进行。
辩论.pinyin: Wǒ rèn wèi biàn lùn gāi jì xù jìn xíng
辩论.en: I believe that the debate should be carried on.

狡猾.zh: 人们说，狐狸比其他动物要狡猾。
狡猾.pinyin: Rén men shuō hú li bǐ qí tā dòng wù yào jiǎo huá
狡猾.en: People say that the fox is more cunning than other animals.
狡猾.es: La gente dice que el zorro es más astuto que otros animales.

狡猾.pinyin: Dé guó rén hěn jiǎo huá

总共.zh: 我今天总共买了十本书。
总共.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān zǒng gòng mǎi le shí běn shū
总共.en: Today, I bought ten books in all.

总共.pinyin: Zǒng gòng yǒu wǔ shí gè rén
总共.en: There were fifty persons in all.

打工.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ zài chāo shì dǎ gōng
打工.en: I work part-time at the supermarket on weekends.

打工.zh: 淑华说她明年想出国打工，结果被家人劝退。
打工.pinyin: Shū huà shuō tā míng nián xiǎng chū guó dǎ gōng jié guǒ bèi jiā rén quàn tuì
打工.en: Shu-hwa said she wanted to work abroad next year, but her family talked her out of it.

海关.zh: 我在机场被海关人员搜查。
海关.pinyin: Wǒ zài jī chǎng bèi hǎi guān rén yuán sōu chá
海关.en: I was searched by the customs officers at the airport.

海关.pinyin: Bāo guǒ bèi hǎi guān kòu le
海关.en: The package was seized by customs.

输入.zh: 你要先输入好个人资料，然后才能买票。
输入.pinyin: Nǐ yào xiān shū rù hǎo gè rén zī liào rán hòu cái néng mǎi piào
输入.en: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.
输入.es: Para comprar una entrada, hay que entrar tus detalles personales.

输入.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shū rù mì mǎ

依靠.zh: 她现在依然依靠父母生活。
依靠.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài yī rán yī kào fù mǔ shēng huó
依靠.en: She's still dependent on her parents.
依靠.es: Ella sigue dependiendo de sus padres.

依靠.pinyin: Wǒ méi shén me kě yī kào de le
依靠.en: I have nothing to fall back on.

依靠.zh: 把你的肩膀借给我让我依靠。
依靠.pinyin: Bǎ nǐ de jiān bǎng jiè gěi wǒ ràng wǒ yī kào
依靠.en: Lend me your shoulder for me to lean on.

依靠.zh: 现在她没了工作，我们再不能依靠她了。
依靠.pinyin: Xiàn zài tā méi le gōng zuò wǒ men zài bù néng yī kào tā le
依靠.en: Now that she has quit her job, we can't depend on her.

惩罚.zh: 要是我们做了同样的事，我们将会受到惩罚。
惩罚.pinyin: Yào shi wǒ men zuò le tóng yàng de shì wǒ men jiāng huì shòu dào chéng fá
惩罚.en: Were we to do such a thing, we should be punished.
惩罚.es: Si hacemos eso, debemos ser castigados.

惩罚.pinyin: Nín wèi shén me chéng fá tā men
惩罚.en: What are you punishing them for?

惩罚.zh: 如果他犯了罪，他应该受到惩罚。
惩罚.pinyin: Rú guǒ tā fàn le zuì tā yīng gāi shòu dào chéng fá
惩罚.en: He must be fined if he breaks the law.
惩罚.es: Él debería ser castigado si comete un crimen.

惩罚.zh: 触犯法律的人受到惩罚。
惩罚.pinyin: Chù fàn fǎ lǜ de rén shòu dào chéng fá
惩罚.en: People who break the law are punished.
惩罚.es: La gente que quebranta la ley es castigada.

枝.pinyin: Tāng mǔ gěi le wǒ yī zhī bǐ
枝.es: Tom me ha dado un bolígrafo.

枝.pinyin: Zhè jǐ zhī bǐ shì shéi de

枝.zh: 能借枝笔吗？我这枝要不行了。
枝.pinyin: Néng jiè zhī bǐ ma wǒ zhè zhī yào bù xíng le
枝.en: Can I borrow a pen? Mine's on its last legs.
枝.es: ¿Puedo tomar prestado un bolígrafo? El mío está en las últimas.

枝.zh: 母亲在我的生日蛋糕上插上了十三枝蜡烛。
枝.pinyin: Mǔ qīn zài wǒ de shēng rì dàn gāo shàng chā shang le shí sān zhī là zhú
枝.en: My mother put thirteen candles on my birthday cake.
枝.es: Mi madre ha puesto trece velas en mi tarta de cumpleaños.

窝.zh: 这个窝棚是个很特别的地方。
窝.pinyin: Zhè ge wō péng shì gè hěn tè bié de dì fang
窝.en: This hut is a very special place.
窝.es: Esta cabaña es un lugar muy especial.

窝.zh: 总有一天孩子们会离开自己的小窝。
窝.pinyin: Zǒng yǒu yī tiān hái zi men huì lí kāi zì jǐ de xiǎo wō
窝.en: Children all leave the nest one day.
窝.es: Todos los hijos abandonan el nido algún día.

窝.zh: 一窝黄蜂袭击了孩子们。
窝.pinyin: Yī wō huáng fēng xí jī le hái zi men
窝.en: A swarm of hornets attacked the children.
窝.es: Un enjambre de avispones atacó a los niños.

窝.zh: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。
窝.pinyin: Jīn wō yín wō bù rú zì jǐ de gǒu wō
窝.en: There is no place like home.
窝.es: No hay nada como el hogar.

锋利.zh: 这把菜刀不够锋利，所以我用了我的折叠刀来切肉。
锋利.pinyin: Zhè bǎ cài dāo bù gòu fēng lì suǒ yǐ wǒ yòng le wǒ de zhé dié dāo lái qiē ròu
锋利.en: The kitchen knife wasn't sharp enough to cut the meat, so I used my pocket knife.
锋利.es: El cuchillo de cocina no estaba lo suficientemente afilado para cortar la carne, así que me serví de mi navaja de bolsillo.

锋利.pinyin: Zhè bǎ dāo bù gòu fēng lì
锋利.es: Este cuchillo no va a cortar bien.

锋利.pinyin: Zhè bǎ dāo hěn fēng lì

鸽子.pinyin: Tā de shí yàn yòng le gē zi
鸽子.en: He used pigeons in his experiment.
鸽子.es: Él utilizó palomas en su experimento.

鸽子.zh: 基顿把磁铁放在他的鸽子的头上。
鸽子.pinyin: Jī dùn bǎ cí tiě fàng zài tā de gē zi de tóu shàng
鸽子.en: Keeton put magnets on the heads of his pigeons.
鸽子.es: Keeton puso imanes sobre las cabezas de sus palomas.

鸽子.zh: 波士顿的鸽子又胖又自豪。
鸽子.pinyin: Bō shì dùn de gē zi yòu pàng yòu zì háo
鸽子.en: The pigeons of Boston are fat and proud.
鸽子.es: Las palomas de Boston son gordas y orgullosas.

鸽子.zh: 他放我鸽子；我等了他一整晚！
鸽子.pinyin: Tā fàng wǒ gē zi wǒ děng le tā yī zhěng wǎn
鸽子.en: He stood me up; I waited all evening for him!

发呆.zh: 望着天花板发呆,还不如读一读小说。
发呆.pinyin: Wàng zhe tiān huā bǎn fā dāi hái bù rú dú yī dú xiǎo shuō
发呆.en: You might as well read a novel instead of staring at the ceiling.
发呆.es: Podrías estar leyendo una novela en vez de estar mirando el techo.

打包.zh: 她帮我打包我的手提箱。
打包.pinyin: Tā bāng wǒ dǎ bāo wǒ de shǒu tí xiāng
打包.en: She helped me pack my suitcase.

打包.pinyin: Kàn lai wǒ men de dǎ bāo le
打包.en: I think we need a doggy bag.

打包.zh: 我觉得我们需要一个打包盒。
打包.pinyin: Wǒ jué de wǒ men xū yào yī ge dǎ bāo hé
打包.en: I think we need a doggy bag.

打包.zh: 我当时正忙着打包，因为我两天后要去法国。
打包.pinyin: Wǒ dāng shí zhèng máng zhe dǎ bāo yīn wèi wǒ liǎng tiān hòu yào qù fǎ guó
打包.en: I was busy packing, because I was leaving for France in two days.

畏惧.zh: 孤独的人会孤独，是因为他畏惧他人。
畏惧.pinyin: Gū dú de rén huì gū dú shì yīn wèi tā wèi jù tā rén
畏惧.en: Lonely people perpetuate their own loneliness through their fear of others.
畏惧.es: La gente solitaria perpetúa su propia soledad a través de su miedo a los demás.

畏惧.zh: 天使畏惧处, 愚人敢闯入。
畏惧.pinyin: Tiān shǐ wèi jù chǔ yú rén gǎn chuǎng rù
畏惧.en: Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
畏惧.es: Los necios se apresuran a entrar donde los ángeles temen pisar.

畏惧.pinyin: Tā bìng bù wèi jù tā

废墟.zh: 暴风雨过后，他们的房子成了废墟。
废墟.pinyin: Bào fēng yǔ guò hòu tā men de fáng zi chéng le fèi xū
废墟.en: After the hurricane, their house was a wreck.
废墟.es: Tras el huracán, su casa era una ruina.

废墟.zh: 一连串的爆炸使实验室成为废墟。
废墟.pinyin: Yī lián chuàn de bào zhà shǐ shí yàn shì chéng wéi fèi xū
废墟.en: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
废墟.es: Una serie de explosiones dejó el laboratorio en ruinas.

废墟.zh: 城堡如今已经成了废墟。
废墟.pinyin: Chéng bǎo rú jīn yǐ jīng chéng le fèi xū
废墟.en: The castle is now in ruins.

盗窃.es: Robaron nuestra casa mientras estábamos fuera.

遥远.en: I'm going back to a place that is far away, don't ask me where.

遥远.pinyin: Xiàn zài wǒ men hěn róng yì jiù néng chéng fēi jī qù yáo yuǎn de guó dù

遥远.pinyin: Xīng xing tài yáo yuǎn le

全力以赴.pinyin: Tā zài quán lì yǐ fù
全力以赴.es: Él lo está haciendo lo mejor que puede.

不妨.pinyin: Nǐ bù fáng gào su wǒ yī qiè
不妨.en: You may as well tell me all about it.
不妨.es: También deberías contarme todo sobre ello.

况且.zh: 你这么漂亮，况且又这么聪明，怎么可能没人追你呢？

反馈.zh: 公司欢迎消费者对他们产品的反馈

反馈.en: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.

巩固.zh: 真正的王在巩固他的权利，然而虚假的王却在打高尔夫。

狭隘.zh: 别让狭隘的人让你相信你的梦想过於宏大。

狭隘.en: Don't let narrow-minded people convince you that your dreams are too big.

繁华.zh: 阿尔及尔是一座有着超过三百多万人口的繁华都市。
繁华.pinyin: Ā ěr jí ěr shì yī zuò yǒu zhe chāo guò sān bǎi duō wàn rén kǒu de fán huá dū shì
繁华.en: Algiers is a bustling city of over three million people.

落成.zh: 新的社区中心在昨天隆重落成。

落成.en: The new community center was inaugurated yesterday with pomp and circumstance.

话.zh: 我想知道这句话的意思。

话.en: A stranger spoke to me on the bus.

不在.pinyin: Wǒ xià zhōu rì bù zài jiā
不在.en: I won't be home next Sunday.

吃饭.zh: 我们今晚出去吃饭，你说怎么样？
吃饭.pinyin: Wǒ men jīn wǎn chū qù chī fàn nǐ shuō zěn me yàng
吃饭.en: What do you say to dining out tonight?
吃饭.es: Esta noche salimos a cenar, ¿qué me dices?

吃饭.en: When are we eating? I'm hungry!

想法.pinyin: Nǐ zhè yàng de xiǎng fǎ shì duì de
想法.en: You are correct in thinking so.
想法.es: Estás en lo correcto al pensar así.

想法.zh: 你的想法和她的想法有甚么不同吗？

想法.en: Is there any difference between your idea and hers?
想法.es: ¿Tu idea y la de ella se diferencian en algo?

想法.zh: 我期待听到你在这件事上的想法 。
想法.pinyin: Wǒ qī dài tīng dào nǐ zài zhè jiàn shì shàng de xiǎng fǎ
想法.en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.
想法.es: Estoy impaciente por escuchar qué piensas de este tema.

想法.zh: 我们通常会对其他人隐瞒自己的想法。
想法.pinyin: Wǒ men tōng cháng huì duì qí tā rén yǐn mán zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ
想法.en: We can normally conceal our thoughts from others.
想法.es: Normalmente podemos ocultar nuestros pensamientos de los demás.

不用.pinyin: Bù yòng tè dì lái wǒ jiā le

不用.en: We use chopsticks in place of knives and forks.

快点.zh: 快点，不然你就要错过火车了。
快点.pinyin: Kuài diǎn bù rán nǐ jiù yào cuò guò huǒ chē le
快点.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.

快点.zh: 你动作快点就能赶上他。
快点.pinyin: Nǐ dòng zuò kuài diǎn jiù néng gǎn shàng tā
快点.en: If you hurry, you'll catch up with him.
快点.es: Si te das prisa, le alcanzarás.

快点.zh: 我爷爷农场养的火鸡吵得要命，真想它们快点被人吃掉。

快点.zh: 我们别在这里等了，还是快点回家吧。

星期一.pinyin: Tā xīng qī yī zǒng shì zài jiā

教堂.pinyin: Zuì jìn de jiào táng zài nǎ lǐ
Zhè lǐ yǐ qián yǒu yī jiān jiào táng

教堂.zh: 我每天都从那座教堂前经过。
教堂.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu cóng nà zuò jiào táng qián jīng guò
教堂.en: I go by that church every day.
教堂.es: Todos los días paso por esa iglesia.

教堂.pinyin: Hé biān de lǎo jiào táng hěn piào liang
教堂.en: The old church by the lake is very beautiful.

四十.pinyin: Wǒ men bān yǒu sì shí gè xué sheng

四十.en: She married again in her mid-forties.

知道了.zh: 我父亲让我知道了我自己是谁。

知道了.en: My father made me what I am.

知道了.zh: 贝蒂说话的口气像是她知道了一切。

知道了.en: Betty talks as if she knew everything.

不动.pinyin: Wǒ lèi de zǒu bù dòng le

不动.es: Estoy tan cansado que no puedo andar más.

Tā men lèi de pá bù dòng shān le

秋天.pinyin: Wǒ qiū tiān yào qù bā lí

星星.pinyin: Zhè shì yī běn guān yú xīng xing de shū
星星.en: This is a book about stars.

星星.zh: 在门上有一个大大的金色星星。

星星.en: There was a big gold star on the door.
星星.es: Había una gran estrella dorada en la puerta.

星星.zh: 所有饼乾都是星星的形状。
星星.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu bǐng gān dōu shì xīng xing de xíng zhuàng
星星.en: All of the cookies are in the shape of stars.
星星.es: Las galletas son todas en forma de estrella.

花瓶.zh: 请小心别打碎了这个花瓶。
花瓶.pinyin: Qǐng xiǎo xīn bié dǎ suì le zhè ge huā píng
花瓶.en: Please take care not to break this vase.
花瓶.es: Ten cuidado de no romper esta jarra, por favor.

花瓶.zh: 花瓶在桌上留下了水迹。

花瓶.en: The wet vase left a mark on the table.
花瓶.es: El jarrón mojado dejó una marca en la mesa.

花瓶.pinyin: Huā píng shuāi chéng suì piàn le
花瓶.en: The vase crashed and shattered into pieces.
花瓶.es: El jarrón se quebró en pedazos.

花瓶.zh: 我把你的花瓶打破了，真对不起。

身边.en: If you are by my side, I don't need anything else.
身边.es: Si estás a mi lado no necesito nada más.

身边.es: Tienes a tu alrededor muchos amigos que se preocupan por ti.

小镇.zh: 小镇被暴风雨后的洪水摧毁了。

小镇.en: The town was destroyed by the flood after the storm.

小镇.en: The town was full of activity.

鸟儿.en: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
鸟儿.es: Encontré un ave que tenía el ala gravemente dañada.

鸟儿.pinyin: Zǎo qǐ de niǎor yǒu chóng chī
鸟儿.en: The early bird catches the worm.
鸟儿.es: A quien madruga Dios le ayuda.

鸟儿.en: The girl released the birds from the cage.
鸟儿.es: La niña liberó a las aves de la jaula.

不合.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié zi bù hé wǒ de jiǎo

不合.en: In our time, there were many students who passed the graduation exam without studying.
不合.es: En nuestros tiempos, había muchos estudiantes que aprobaban el examen de graduación sin estudiar.

不合.zh: 这个岗位不合适小姑娘。

门把手.zh: 我试著开门的时候门把手自己掉了下来。

代理人.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.

份子.en: I am proud to be a part of this project.

内行.en: He seems very interested in musical theatre and the like, and he also seems quite adept.

搭便车.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐ huan dā biàn chē

搭便车.zh: 汤姆搭便车去波士顿了。
搭便车.pinyin: Tāng mǔ dā biàn chē qù bō shì dùn le
搭便车.en: Tom hitched a ride to Boston.

文身.pinyin: Wǒ bì xū bǎ wén shēn qù diào
文身.en: I had to get my tattoo removed.

文身.zh: 汤姆在胸上有个头骨文身。
文身.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zài xiōng shàng yǒu gè tóu gǔ wén shēn
文身.en: Tom has a tattoo of a skull on his chest.

晾衣绳.zh: 玛丽把她的衣服挂在晾衣绳上。
晾衣绳.pinyin: Mǎ lì bǎ tā de yī fu guà zài liàng yī shéng shàng
晾衣绳.en: Mary hung her clothes on the clothesline.

晾衣绳.zh: 汤姆在两棵树之间拉起了一条晾衣绳。
晾衣绳.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zài liǎng kē shù zhī jiān lā qǐ le yī tiáo liàng yī shéng
晾衣绳.en: Tom strung a clothesline between the two trees.

朝着.pinyin: Tā cháo zhe gǒu rēng le kuài shí tou
朝着.en: He threw a stone at the dog.

朝着.zh: 他朝着大狗扔了块石头。
朝着.pinyin: Tā cháo zhe dà gǒu rēng le kuài shí tou
朝着.en: He threw a stone at the big dog.

浩瀚.pinyin: Yǔ zhòu hào hàn wú biān

温哥华.zh: 下周我去温哥华看我妹妹。
温哥华.pinyin: Xià zhōu wǒ qù wēn gē huá kàn wǒ mèi mei
温哥华.en: I'm going off to Vancouver next week to see my sister.
温哥华.es: La semana que viene voy a Vancouver a ver a mi hermana pequeña.

温哥华.zh: 我想订一张去温哥华的机票。
温哥华.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dìng yī zhāng qù wēn gē huá de jī piào
温哥华.en: I'd like to reserve a flight to Vancouver.
温哥华.es: Desearía reservar un vuelo a Vancouver.

溜冰鞋.pinyin: Wǒ miǎn fèi dé dào liū bīng xié
溜冰鞋.en: I got the roller skates for nothing.
溜冰鞋.es: Me dieron los patines por nada.

溜冰鞋.pinyin: Bié wàng le ná liū bīng xié
溜冰鞋.es: No olvides tus patines de hielo.

生啤酒.zh: 生啤酒在大热天时特别好喝。
生啤酒.pinyin: Shēng pí jiǔ zài dà rè tiān shí tè bié hǎo hē
生啤酒.en: Draft beer tastes especially good on a hot day.
生啤酒.es: La cerveza de barril sabe especialmente buena en un día caliente.

生啤酒.pinyin: Wǒ men bù mài shēng pí jiǔ

绿灯.pinyin: Lǜ dēng shí guǎi wān chē yào ràng rén
绿灯.en: When the light is green, cars turning must yield to pedestrians.

耻辱.pinyin: Nà shi yī ge chǐ rǔ

自投罗网.pinyin: Nǐ zì tóu luó wǎng le
自投罗网.es: Te has metido en una trampa.

药店.pinyin: Zuì jìn de yào diàn zài nǎ lǐ

西藏.zh: 西藏的好水就是世界的好水。
西藏.pinyin: Xī zàng de hǎo shuǐ jiù shì shì jiè de hǎo shuǐ
西藏.en: Good water for Tibet is good water for the world.

谋利.zh: 他在利用集体的名义，为自己谋利。
谋利.pinyin: Tā zài lì yòng jí tǐ de míng yì wèi zì jǐ móu lì
谋利.en: He is making use of the collective's name for his own profit.

谷仓.zh: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。
谷仓.pinyin: Wèi duǒ bì fēng bào wǒ men duǒ dào le fù jìn de yī ge gǔ cāng nèi
谷仓.en: We took refuge from the storm in a nearby barn.

静止.zh: 在他们双目交接的瞬间，世界仿佛静止了。
静止.pinyin: Zài tā men shuāng mù jiāo jiē de shùn jiān shì jiè fǎng fú jìng zhǐ le
静止.en: When their eyes met, it was as if the world stood still.

静止.zh: 那一刻，时间仿佛静止了。
静止.pinyin: Nà yī kè shí jiān fǎng fú jìng zhǐ le
静止.en: At that moment, time seemed to stand still.

预防性.zh: 避孕套可以预防性传播疾病。
预防性.pinyin: Bì yùn tào kě yǐ yù fáng xìng chuán bō jí bìng
预防性.es: Los preservativos ofrecen protección contra las enfermedades de transmisión sexual.

黑车.pinyin: Wǒ huái yí zhè shì liàng hēi chē
黑车.en: I am suspicious that this is an illegal taxi.
黑车.es: Yo sospecho de que este sea un taxi ilegal.

黑车.pinyin: Shì hēi chē ma wǒ wèn tā
黑车.en: "Is it an illegal taxi?" I ask him.

三番五次.pinyin: Tā sān fān wǔ cì píng pàn bié ren
三番五次.en: He judges other people time and again.

不可缺少.zh: 水是生命所不可缺少的。
不可缺少.pinyin: Shuǐ shì shēng mìng suǒ bù kě quē shǎo de

不怎么样.pinyin: Yīn yuè huì bù zěn me yàng
不怎么样.es: El concierto no fue muy bueno.

不成材.zh: 就是因为他不成材他爸看不起他。
不成材.pinyin: Jiù shì yīn wèi tā bù chéng cái tā bà kàn bu qǐ tā
不成材.en: It's just that because he hasn't made something of himself, his father won't look at him.

中常.zh: 文学作品中常用夜来香来象徵思念与柔情。
中常.pinyin: Wén xué zuò pǐn zhōng cháng yòng yè lái xiāng lái xiàng zhēng sī niàn yǔ róu qíng
中常.en: In literary works, night-blooming jasmine is often used to symbolize longing and tenderness.
中常.es: En obras literarias, el galán de noche muchas veces simboliza el anhelo y la ternura.

主唱.zh: 很难找到一位没有在其他乐团工作的优秀主唱。
主唱.pinyin: Hěn nán zhǎo dào yī wèi méi yǒu zài qí tā yuè tuán gōng zuò de yōu xiù zhǔ chàng
主唱.en: It'll be hard to find a good vocalist who isn't already working with another band.

五十步笑百步.pinyin: Wǔ shí bù xiào bǎi bù
五十步笑百步.en: The pot calls the kettle black.
